description: Get the public facts of one event by its id from search: dates, location, public deadlines, official and source URLs, and the public calendar feeds that contain it.
name: fetch

category_key.description: Category key, or null for the top calendar of the field.
category_key.title: Category Key

webcal_url.description: ICS feed URL for one-click subscribe.
webcal_url.title: Webcal Url

date.description: ISO date, or empty when not announced.
date.title: Date

deadline_type.description: full_paper, extended_abstract, abstract, panel_proposal, call_for_works, application, registration, notification (a decision date), or empty when not yet typed.
deadline_type.title: Deadline Type

open_call.description: True when the deadline is open and asks for a submission or an application. Registration, decision and untyped deadlines are never open calls.
open_call.title: Open Call

kind.description: Eligibility: career_stage, membership, affiliation, group, region, nomination or unpublished_only. Submission: format, length, method, document or template.
kind.title: Kind

calendars.description: Public calendar feeds that contain this event.
calendars.title: Calendars

eligibility.description: Each restriction on who may submit, with its source.
eligibility.title: Eligibility

submission.description: How to submit: format, length, method, documents, template.
submission.title: Submission

submission_checked_on.description: Date (ISO) of the check of how to submit, or empty.
submission_checked_on.title: Submission Checked On

submission_ready.description: True when the deadline, its type, the submission method and who may submit are all checked.
submission_ready.title: Submission Ready

who_may_submit.description: Who may submit, for example 'PhD students only' or 'Open to everyone'; empty when not checked.
who_may_submit.title: Who May Submit

text.description: Plain-text summary of the event facts.
text.title: Text

title: Get event details
